_lisezmoi: Every rule and date the site applies lives here, read on the official source cited, never typed into a page (RECETTE §4). Holiday dates are not stored: the engine computes them from the rules below and tests compare them with the OPM and Federal Reserve tables.

holidays._source: 5 U.S.C. 6103(a), read on govinfo.gov on 2026-10-28; observance: 5 U.S.C. 6103(b) (Saturday to Friday) and Executive Order 11582 sec. 3(a) (Sunday to Monday), as stated on the OPM federal holidays page read the same day.

list.name: Birthday of Martin Luther King, Jr.

fed._source: Federal Reserve Financial Services, Holiday Schedules (FedCash schedule 2026 to 2030 and FedACH holiday schedule 2026), read on frbservices.org on 2026-10-28.
fed.saturdayRule: For holidays falling on Saturday, Federal Reserve Banks and Branches will be open the preceding Friday.
fed.sundayRule: For holidays falling on Sunday, Federal Reserve Banks and Branches will be closed the following Monday.

leaveYears._source: OPM fact sheet Leave Year Beginning and Ending Dates, read on opm.gov on 2026-10-28. A leave year begins on the first day of the first full biweekly pay period in a calendar year (5 CFR 630.201).
leaveYears._note2031: 2031-01-05 is the day after the 2030 leave year ends on 2031-01-04 in the same OPM table.

federalPay._source: 5 U.S.C. 5504: the pay period covers two administrative workweeks; hourly rate = annual rate / 2,087, rounded to the nearest cent; biweekly rate = hourly rate x 80. Read on govinfo.gov on 2026-10-28.
federalPay.memo27: OPM CPM 2023-11 (June 26, 2023): leave year 2023 had 27 pay periods for most employees, but most employees still had 26 paydays in calendar year 2023; leave accrual follows pay periods, not paydays.

dst._source: 15 U.S.C. 260a(a): daylight saving time runs from 2 a.m. on the second Sunday of March to 2 a.m. on the first Sunday of November (as amended by Pub. L. 109-58, effective 2007). Read on govinfo.gov on 2026-10-28; NIST page read the same day.

bill.name: Sunshine Protection Act
bill.status: Referred to the Senate Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation; not law as of 2026-10-28

flsa._source: 29 CFR 778.104, 778.105, 778.106 and 778.113 read on ecfr.gov on 2026-10-28; DOL FLSA Hours Worked Advisor, Daylight Savings Time screen, read on webapps.dol.gov the same day.
